title: iOS 1.15 — Surface charts, My Aircraft and lightning
body:
- Surface charts and GRAMET in the app: the Discussion tab now shows the DWD, Met Office and TEMSI surface charts and the GRAMET cross-section for your route, even for briefings without an AI digest.
- My Aircraft: view, add, edit and delete your aircraft from Settings, and choose which one is your default.
- Runway wind at a glance: the Observed tab shows your departure and destination runways with the current wind, so crosswind and headwind are easy to read.
- Lightning on the route map: recent strikes appear as small bolts that fade with age, with a toggle to hide them and the time of the latest data.
- Clearer route ribbon: storms, stations and SIGMETs are described by the nearest place along your route, and a cell's motion is now shown as an arrow rather than a confusing dot.
- Shared map links open where the sender was looking, instead of on the default Europe view.
- Fixed: the map's close button could be missing on larger iPhones in landscape and on iPad, leaving you stuck on the map.
